result.instructions: Tools for eCellar, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which club members signed up in the last 30 days, and which tier did each join?"; "List this week's unshipped web orders with their shipping states."; "How many bottles of each SKU are available at the Tasting Room right now?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes eCellar data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run ecellar_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run ecellar_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run ecellar_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. ecellar_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: ecellar_get_reference_data
tools.title: Get reference data
tools.description: Lookup lists of the winery's eCellar account: brands = brands (brand_key + name); locations = locations (location_id, name, timezone); customer_types = customer types; customer_sources = customer sources; customer_tags = customer tags; order_tags = order tags (tag groups and tags); reservation_types = reservation types; terminals = POS terminals; billing_statuses = billing statuses (enum values for the orders filter billing_statuses); purchase_statuses = order statuses (enum values for the orders filter purchase_statuses); purchase_sources = order sources (Web, POS, club, phone...); carriers = carriers (enum values for ecellar_add_order_tracking carrier_enum); payment_types = payment types; card_types = card types; note_types = customer note types; product_availabilities = product availabilities; product_statuses = product statuses; reservation_statuses = reservation statuses; fulfillment_companies = fulfillment companies; state_codes = state codes; country_codes = country codes. Use brands first: the brand_key values filter orders, club tiers, events and reservations. GET /client/* or /types/*.

tools.name: ecellar_mark_order_shipped
tools.title: Mark order shipped
tools.description: WRITE: set the shipped date and status of ONE order, to be used when ALL its packages have shipped. eCellar refuses it unless the order status is EXPORTED, HOLD_SHIP, SHIPPED, TO_PICKUP or UNSHIPPED, the date is not before the order date, and the date matches the latest tracking ship date. Check the order and its tracking records first. PATCH /order/{order_id}/shipped.

tools.name: ecellar_mark_order_delivered
tools.title: Mark order delivered
tools.description: WRITE: set the delivered date and status of ONE order, to be used when ALL its packages were delivered. eCellar refuses it unless the order status is DELIVERED or SHIPPED and the date matches the latest tracking delivered date. PATCH /order/{order_id}/delivered.

date_delivered.description: Date the order was fully delivered (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: ecellar_add_order_tracking
tools.title: Add order tracking record
tools.description: WRITE: add a carrier tracking record (carrier + tracking number, optional shipped/delivered dates) to ONE order. Adds a record each call; a duplicate tracking number on the same order is refused by eCellar. Get carrier_enum from ecellar_get_reference_data carriers. POST /order/{order_id}/tracking.

carrier_enum.description: Carrier enum value (from the carriers reference list).

tools.name: ecellar_adjust_inventory_count
tools.title: Adjust inventory count
tools.description: WRITE: change the on-hand count of ONE SKU at ONE location by a signed amount (+12 adds, -3 removes; it is a delta, not a new total, so repeating it repeats the change). Pass location_id or location_name; eCellar refuses an unknown or ambiguous location, a SKU that is not at that location, or a result below zero. Check ecellar_get_inventory_counts first. PATCH /inventory/counts/{SKU}.

sku.description: The SKU (SKU from ecellar_search_products inventory_skus or ecellar_get_inventory_counts).

on_hand_adjustment.description: Signed change of the on-hand count.

location_name.description: Inventory location name (use instead of location_id).
